#	Dave solo
*	Whole show with Doug Wannamaker on organ (aside from Dave solo).
@	Nature intro
$	Pretty girl outro
%	'Shortenin Bread' tease
&	with Mike Durham on guitar
!	with Mike Durham on guitar and Oteil Burbridge on bass
^	'Woody Woodpecker' and 'Popeye the Sailor' teases

Notes:
----------
*	There was a previously circulating set of SHNs for this show
	converted by Allan Chen.  That set of SHNs was incomplete, so
	this set of SHNs should replace them.
*	R&R fades in during Dave singing.  Most documented copies of
	this show have the same problem.
*	There was a 2 second diginoise rip around 3:00 in Two Step that
	I fixed with a patch of audio from another DAT I had.
*	There are some level adjustments during Jimi Thing.
*	There are some level adjustments at the beginning of Ants.
*	There was a nasty feedback pop edited out at 17:13 in #36.

*  compiled by Louie Rendek <<email>> on January 17th, 2004.
